_comment: playlist_app.py: one shuffle bag of shader Setups (shaders/<name>/), each put in setup_copies times so videos come round less often, and videos (files in videos/, which is gitignored — copy them onto the show PC). Each Setup plays setup_duration_s, overriding its own duration_s; each video plays to the end of its file, silent and letterboxed. A missing or unreadable item is skipped. The interstitial Setup plays for interstitial_s between every two items.
